story.text: Mr. Rochester longs to load his bride with {JEWELS}. At a silk warehouse he picks an amethyst silk and a {PINK} satin, and Jane begs him down to sober black satin and pearl-grey. She would be “a jay in borrowed {PLUMES}.” Two nights before the {WEDDING}, she wakes to see a {GHASTLY} woman put on her {VEIL}, tear it in two, and {TRAMPLE} it. In the {MORNING}, the torn veil lies on the floor.
story.caption: It removed my veil from its gaunt head, rent it in two parts, and trampled on them
